title: Zenith Dense Japanese Pork Tamagoyaki
description: A cultured and dense Japanese dish from the Tohoku region, featuring pork buns and yakimono-grilled ingredients in a low-sodium tamagoyaki form.
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together yakimono sauce, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar.
Add the sliced pork loin to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and set aside.
Remove the pork from the marinade and coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Brush the yakimono grill with sesame oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the pork for 5 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
In a small bowl, mix the beaten eggs with a small amount of the marinade.
Pour the egg mixture into a tamagoyaki pan and cook over medium heat.
Once the eggs are almost set, add the grilled pork to the center of the tamagoyaki and roll into a dense cylinder.
